caption: The drawing features a rectangular piece of patterned textile centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The textile design consists of alternating vertical stripes that vary in width. The wider stripes contain intricate floral motifs in pink with small hints of blue, arranged along a central vine. In between these floral stripes, there are narrower geometric stripes featuring a repeating linear meander (key) design in pink set against a lighter cream or pale background. The textile is bordered on all sides by thin vertical lines in gold and pink. The composition is flat, with the textile placed horizontally, and there is a handwritten note or signature in the bottom left corner of the plain background, reading "James Joslin 1838."
title: Girl's Wrapper - Textile Pattern
